entry.cost: Free to audit; certificate fee listed on page
entry.name: AI for Everyone
entry.note: A non-technical course on what AI can and cannot do inside an organisation
entry.audience: Managers, executives and anyone working alongside technical teams

reading.cost: The page offers a Join for Free option and refers to purchasing a Certificate, but it does not state a price.
covers: Common AI terminology, including neural networks, machine learning, deep learning and data science
What AI realistically can and cannot do
Spotting opportunities to apply AI to problems in your own organization
What it feels like to build machine learning and data science projects
Working with an AI team and building an AI strategy
Ethical and societal discussions surrounding AI
Workflow of a machine learning project
reading.format: The course is delivered as video lessons grouped into sections, with a total listed time of 71 minutes, 7 minutes, 30 minutes, 52 minutes, 5 minutes, 90 minutes, 6 minutes, 50 minutes and 15 minutes across its parts. The page mentions graded assignments as part of the materials available with a Certificate purchase.
reading.summary: This is a beginner level course about artificial intelligence aimed at a broad audience. It explains common AI terms and what AI can and cannot do. It also covers how to find AI opportunities in an organization and how to work with an AI team. Completing it shows familiarity with AI concepts and the business side of AI.
reading.audience: The page says the course is for anyone who wants their organization to use AI better, especially non-technical colleagues. It adds that engineers can also take it to learn the business aspects of AI.
reading.prerequisites: The page lists the course as beginner level and does not state any required or recommended prior knowledge.
